nodes.label: NIST FIPS 205 SLH-DSA Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard
nodes.description: Finalized NIST post-quantum digital signature standard derived from SPHINCS+, offering stateless security relying exclusively on collision-resistant cryptographic hash functions.

nodes.label: ARM Confidential Compute Architecture (ARM CCA) & RME Framework
nodes.description: Hardware security architecture introducing Realm Management Extensions (RME) to isolate executing virtual machines and workloads from hypervisors or host OS.

nodes.label: MARBERT Dialectal and Modern Standard Arabic Transformer Model
nodes.description: Large-scale pre-trained transformer model optimized specifically for Dialectal Arabic (DA) and Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) text representations.

nodes.label: W3C N-Triples Line-Based RDF Dataset Serialization Standard
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation defining a plain-text, line-oriented format for encoding RDF graphs where each triple is expressed on a distinct line ending with a period.

nodes.label: SuiteSparse SPQR Multifrontal QR Factorization Algorithm
nodes.description: Multifrontal sparse QR factorization algorithm optimized for solving large-scale sparse least-squares problems and structural rank computations in graph topology analysis.
